answer: Put a forge on the mesa: every head must smelt its own ore into a blade that carries a signature only that head could strike, and the blade is quenched publicly on the open plateau where all can see the sparks fly. Because a clone can copy the blade but not the strike, borrowed metal fails the ring test on inspection. Standing then grows as a vine along the plateau edge: it only climbs while the head keeps feeding it live work each epoch, and any section left unwatered withers back to the root, so dormant shells cannot bank credit.
